IMPLEMENT THIS EXACT APPROVED LESSON CONTENT:

SUBJECT:
Science

GRADE:
Grade 1

LESSON:
Lesson 3

TITLE:
Our Body & Senses 👀👂

SUBTITLE:
Learn how body parts help us move, explore, and understand the world around us.

ESTIMATED TIME:
20–25 minutes

==================================================
LEARNING GOALS 🎯
==================================================

By the end of this lesson, the learner should be able to:

• Name important external body parts.
• Explain simple jobs of different body parts.
• Identify the five commonly taught senses.
• Match each sense with the body part mainly used for it.
• Describe how our senses help us learn about our surroundings.
• Explain simple ways to protect important sense organs.

==================================================
OPENING — YOUR AMAZING BODY 🧒
==================================================

Your body has many different parts.

Some body parts help you move.

Some help you hold things.

Some help you eat.

Some help you see, hear, smell, taste, and feel.

Your body parts work together every day.

Think about what happens when you see a ball and catch it. ⚽

Your eyes see the ball.

Your brain helps you understand where it is.

Your arms and hands move.

Your fingers help you hold it.

Several parts of your body worked together!

In this lesson, we will learn about:

🧍 body parts

👀 sight

👂 hearing

👃 smell

👅 taste

✋ touch

==================================================
SECTION 1 — IMPORTANT BODY PARTS 🧍
==================================================

Our bodies have many parts.

Each part can have one or more important jobs.

Let's look at some common external body parts.

--------------------------------------------------
HEAD
--------------------------------------------------

Your head is at the top of your body.

It contains important sense organs such as:

👀 eyes

👂 ears

👃 nose

👅 tongue inside the mouth

Your brain is also protected inside your skull.

--------------------------------------------------
NECK
--------------------------------------------------

Your neck connects your head to the rest of your body.

It also helps you turn and move your head.

--------------------------------------------------
ARMS 💪
--------------------------------------------------

Your arms help you:

• reach;
• lift;
• carry;
• push;
• pull.

--------------------------------------------------
HANDS ✋
--------------------------------------------------

Your hands help you:

• hold objects;
• write;
• pick things up;
• feel surfaces;
• perform many careful movements.

--------------------------------------------------
LEGS 🦵
--------------------------------------------------

Your legs help support your body.

They help you:

• stand;
• walk;
• run;
• jump.

--------------------------------------------------
FEET 🦶
--------------------------------------------------

Your feet help support your body and help you move.

==================================================
VISUAL 1 — BASIC BODY PARTS
==================================================

Create a child-friendly full-body illustration.

Label:

Head
Neck
Shoulder
Arm
Hand
Fingers
Leg
Knee
Foot

Use large arrows and simple labels.

Do not overload the image with too many anatomical terms.

Caption:

"Different body parts help us do different jobs."

==================================================
SECTION 2 — BODY PARTS WORK TOGETHER 🤝
==================================================

Your body parts often work together.

Imagine riding a bicycle. 🚲

Your eyes help you see where you are going.

Your hands hold the handlebars.

Your arms help steer.

Your legs push the pedals.

Your feet stay on the pedals.

Your ears may help you notice sounds around you.

Many parts work together to help you ride safely.

💡 REMEMBER:

One action can use several body parts at the same time.

==================================================
SECTION 3 — WHAT ARE SENSES? 🧠
==================================================

Our senses help us collect information about the world around us.

In Grade 1, we usually learn five main senses:

👀 Sight

👂 Hearing

👃 Smell

👅 Taste

✋ Touch

Each sense helps us notice different kinds of information.

Our sense organs collect information, and the brain helps us understand it.

==================================================
VISUAL 2 — THE FIVE SENSES
==================================================

Create a clear five-part visual.

👀 EYES
Sight

👂 EARS
Hearing

👃 NOSE
Smell

👅 TONGUE
Taste

✋ SKIN
Touch

Center label:

"Our senses help us learn about our surroundings."

Use simple icons or child-friendly illustrations.

==================================================
SECTION 4 — SIGHT 👀
==================================================

We use our eyes mainly for sight.

Sight helps us notice:

🎨 colors;

🔺 shapes;

📏 sizes;

📍 locations;

🏃 movement;

🙂 faces;

📖 words and pictures.

--------------------------------------------------
EXAMPLE
--------------------------------------------------

Imagine you see a red apple. 🍎

Your eyes help you notice:

• its red color;
• its round shape;
• where it is.

Sight gives you information before you even touch the apple.

==================================================
SECTION 5 — HEARING 👂
==================================================

We use our ears mainly for hearing.

Hearing helps us notice sounds.

We can hear:

🎵 music;

🗣️ voices;

🐦 birds;

🔔 bells;

🚗 vehicles;

🌧️ rain.

--------------------------------------------------
EXAMPLE
--------------------------------------------------

Suppose you hear a school bell.

Your ears detect the sound.

Your brain helps you recognize what the sound may mean.

Hearing can help us communicate and notice what is happening nearby.

==================================================
SECTION 6 — SMELL 👃
==================================================

We use our nose mainly for smelling.

Smell helps us notice odors in the air.

We may smell:

🌸 flowers;

🍞 bread;

🍊 fruit;

🍲 food;

🌧️ wet soil after rain.

--------------------------------------------------
EXAMPLE
--------------------------------------------------

Imagine you walk near a flower garden.

You may smell the flowers before you touch them.

Your nose helps collect information from the air.

==================================================
SECTION 7 — TASTE 👅
==================================================

Our tongue helps us taste.

Taste helps us notice different flavors in food.

Common taste words include:

🍬 sweet;

🍋 sour;

🧂 salty;

🥬 bitter;

🍲 savory.

Taste and smell can work together.

For example, food may seem different when your nose is blocked.

--------------------------------------------------
SAFETY NOTE ⚠️
--------------------------------------------------

Do not taste unknown things just to learn what they are.

Only taste food or drinks that a trusted adult says are safe.

==================================================
SECTION 8 — TOUCH ✋
==================================================

We sense touch through our skin.

Your skin covers your body.

Touch can help you notice:

🔥 warm;

🧊 cold;

🧸 soft;

🪨 rough;

🪵 hard;

🧽 smooth or bumpy surfaces;

gentle pressure.

--------------------------------------------------
EXAMPLE
--------------------------------------------------

Touch a soft towel.

Then touch a rough rock.

They feel different because your skin can detect information about their surfaces.

⚠️ Never touch something dangerous just to test how it feels.

==================================================
VISUAL 3 — WHAT CAN EACH SENSE NOTICE?
==================================================

Create five simple examples:

👀 Sight
Red flower 🌹

👂 Hearing
Bell 🔔

👃 Smell
Orange 🍊

👅 Taste
Safe food 🍓

✋ Touch
Soft teddy bear 🧸

Caption:

"Different senses give us different kinds of information."

==================================================
SECTION 9 — MORE THAN ONE SENSE AT A TIME 🧠
==================================================

We often use several senses together.

Imagine eating an orange. 🍊

You can:

👀 see its color;

✋ feel its peel;

👃 smell it;

👅 taste it;

👂 hear a small sound as you peel it.

Using several senses can give us more information about an object.

==================================================
WORKED EXAMPLE — EXPLORING AN APPLE 🍎
==================================================

Suppose we want to learn about an apple.

What can our senses tell us?

STEP 1 — SIGHT 👀

We can see that the apple is red and round.

STEP 2 — TOUCH ✋

We can feel that the skin is smooth and firm.

STEP 3 — SMELL 👃

We may notice the apple's smell.

STEP 4 — TASTE 👅

If the apple is safe to eat, we can taste it.

STEP 5 — HEARING 👂

We may hear a crunch when someone bites it.

CONCLUSION:

Several senses can work together to help us learn about one object.

==================================================
SECTION 10 — WHICH SENSE SHOULD I USE? 🤔
==================================================

Different questions may need different senses.

QUESTION:

"What color is the flower?"

Best sense:
👀 Sight

--------------------------------------------------

QUESTION:

"Is the bell ringing?"

Best sense:
👂 Hearing

--------------------------------------------------

QUESTION:

"Does this flower have a smell?"

Best sense:
👃 Smell

--------------------------------------------------

QUESTION:

"Is this towel soft?"

Best sense:
✋ Touch

--------------------------------------------------

QUESTION:

"Does this safe fruit taste sweet?"

Best sense:
👅 Taste

Choosing the right sense helps us gather the information we need.

==================================================
GUIDED EXAMPLE — A RINGING PHONE 📱
==================================================

A phone is somewhere nearby.

You cannot see it yet.

Then you hear it ringing.

Which sense helped you know that something was happening?

👂 Hearing

Your ears detected the sound.

Now suppose you look around and find the phone.

Which sense helped you locate it by looking?

👀 Sight

We can use different senses one after another.

==================================================
SECTION 11 — PROTECTING OUR EYES 👀
==================================================

Our eyes are important.

We should take care of them.

Good habits include:

✅ keeping sharp objects away from the eyes;

✅ using appropriate eye protection when needed;

✅ keeping dirty hands away from the eyes;

✅ telling an adult if your eyes hurt or something gets into them.

Do not stare directly at the Sun. ☀️

Very bright light can harm the eyes.

==================================================
SECTION 12 — PROTECTING OUR EARS 👂
==================================================

Our ears help us hear.

We should protect them too.

Good habits include:

✅ keeping the volume at a comfortable level;

✅ moving away from sounds that are painfully loud;

✅ never pushing objects deep into the ears;

✅ telling an adult if an ear hurts or hearing suddenly changes.

==================================================
SECTION 13 — PROTECTING OUR NOSE, MOUTH, AND SKIN 🧼
==================================================

We can take care of other sense organs too.

--------------------------------------------------
NOSE 👃
--------------------------------------------------

Do not put objects inside the nose.

Avoid smelling unknown chemicals closely.

--------------------------------------------------
MOUTH AND TONGUE 👅
--------------------------------------------------

Only eat and taste safe food.

Brush your teeth and keep your mouth clean.

--------------------------------------------------
SKIN ✋
--------------------------------------------------

Wash your skin regularly.

Protect it from very hot objects.

Tell an adult if you have a painful injury or burn.

==================================================
SECTION 14 — BODY PART OR SENSE? 🔎
==================================================

Body parts can help with actions, while sense organs help us gather information.

Examples:

🦵 Leg
helps us walk and run

✋ Hand
helps us hold objects

👀 Eyes
help us see

👂 Ears
help us hear

👃 Nose
helps us smell

👅 Tongue
helps us taste

🖐️ Skin
helps us sense touch

Some body parts can have more than one job.

For example, your hand can hold something AND the skin on your hand can help you feel it.

==================================================
VISUAL 4 — MATCH THE SENSE TO THE BODY PART
==================================================

Create a simple matching diagram:

Sight → Eyes 👀

Hearing → Ears 👂

Smell → Nose 👃

Taste → Tongue 👅

Touch → Skin ✋

Use arrows or connecting lines.

==================================================
SECTION 15 — OUR BRAIN HELPS US UNDERSTAND 🧠
==================================================

Our eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin collect information.

The brain helps us understand that information.

For example:

You hear a bark. 🐕

Your ears detect the sound.

Your brain helps you recognize that the sound may be a dog.

You see a yellow banana. 🍌

Your eyes detect color and shape.

Your brain helps you recognize the object.

For Grade 1, remember:

"Sense organs collect information. The brain helps us understand it."

==================================================
SECTION 16 — NOT EVERYONE SENSES THE WORLD THE SAME WAY ❤️
==================================================

People can experience the world in different ways.

Some people may not see clearly.

Some may not hear clearly.

They can use tools and other ways to learn and communicate.

Examples can include:

👓 glasses;

🦻 hearing devices;

🦯 mobility tools;

🤟 sign language;

⠿ Braille.

People can learn, communicate, and explore in many different ways.

Treat everyone with respect.

==================================================

==================================================

--------------------------------------------------

You want to know the color of a ball. ⚽

Use:
👀 Sight

--------------------------------------------------

You want to know whether music is playing. 🎵

Use:
👂 Hearing

--------------------------------------------------

You want to know whether a blanket feels soft. 🧸

Use:
✋ Touch

--------------------------------------------------

You want to notice the smell of a flower. 🌸

Use:
👃 Smell

--------------------------------------------------

You want to know the flavor of a safe piece of fruit. 🍓

Use:
👅 Taste

==================================================
COMMON MISTAKES ⚠️
==================================================

MISTAKE 1:

"We only use one sense at a time."

❌ Not true.

We often use several senses together.

--------------------------------------------------

MISTAKE 2:

"Touch only happens in the hands."

❌ Not true.

Your skin covers your whole body and helps you sense touch.

--------------------------------------------------

MISTAKE 3:

"The nose is used for taste."

❌ Not exactly.

The tongue is an important organ for taste.

Smell can also affect how food seems to taste.

--------------------------------------------------

MISTAKE 4:

"Ears only help us when someone is talking."

❌ Not true.

Ears can detect many sounds such as music, bells, animals, and vehicles.

--------------------------------------------------

MISTAKE 5:

"The eyes understand everything we see by themselves."

❌ Not quite.

The eyes collect visual information, and the brain helps us understand it.

==================================================
QUICK CHECK 🧠
==================================================

1. WHICH BODY PART HELPS YOU SEE? 👀

Answer:
Eyes

Why?
Eyes collect visual information.

--------------------------------------------------

2. WHICH SENSE HELPS YOU HEAR A BELL? 🔔

Answer:
Hearing

Why?
Our ears detect sounds.

--------------------------------------------------

3. WHICH BODY PART HELPS YOU SMELL A FLOWER? 🌸

Answer:
Nose

Why?
The nose helps detect smells in the air.

--------------------------------------------------

4. WHICH SENSE HELPS YOU KNOW THAT A BLANKET IS SOFT? 🧸

Answer:
Touch

Why?
The skin helps us feel texture.

--------------------------------------------------

5. CAN MORE THAN ONE SENSE WORK AT THE SAME TIME?

Answer:
Yes

Why?
We often use several senses together to learn more about an object or situation.

==================================================
KEY CONCEPT ⭐
==================================================

TITLE:

Our body parts and senses help us explore the world.

BODY:

Different body parts have different jobs.

Our eyes help us see.

Our ears help us hear.

Our nose helps us smell.

Our tongue helps us taste.

Our skin helps us feel touch.

Our sense organs collect information, and the brain helps us understand it.

==================================================
FINAL RECAP 🌟
==================================================

Remember:

🧍 Our bodies have many different parts.

💪 Arms and hands help us reach, carry, and hold.

🦵 Legs and feet help us stand and move.

👀 Eyes help us see.

👂 Ears help us hear.

👃 The nose helps us smell.

👅 The tongue helps us taste.

✋ Skin helps us feel touch.

🧠 The brain helps us understand information from our senses.

🤝 Several body parts and senses can work together.

🛡️ We should protect our sense organs and use them safely.

==================================================
QUIZ ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

Avoid ambiguous questions.

For example, do NOT ask:

"Which sense do you use when eating?"

because eating may involve sight, smell, taste, touch, and hearing.

Instead ask a specific question such as:

"Which sense helps you notice that a strawberry tastes sweet?"

Correct concept:
Taste

When a situation can involve several senses, clearly ask which sense gives a particular kind of information.

Example:

"Which sense helps you notice the COLOR of an apple?"

Correct:
Sight

"Which sense helps you notice the SMELL of an apple?"

Correct:
Smell

"Which sense helps you notice whether the apple feels smooth?"

Correct:
Touch
